name: io.github.devmster/x402-trinity
title: x402 Trinity
description: Give an agent a wallet. Pays for x402 resources within hard limits. Base + USDC, gasless.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays. Use a dedicated wallet holding only what you would accept losing. The server refuses to start without it.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PER_REQUEST
environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling for a single payment, in atomic units (USDC has 6 decimals, so 50000 is $0.05). Required: a model decides when payments happen, so the cap cannot come from the model.

environmentVariables.name: X402_TOTAL_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime ceiling across all payments, in atomic units. Required for the same reason as the per-request cap.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BUDGET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file that makes the lifetime budget survive restarts. Without it the total resets every time the server starts.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOW_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosts that may be paid. Anything else is refused however convincing the challenge looks.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Networks to accept. Defaults to base.
